normalize_uroman_text: normalize text to lowercase ASCII with only letters, apostrophes, and spaces for uroman processing
get_uroman_tokens: run uroman perl script on normalized transcripts to convert text to romanized tokens for a given ISO language
merge_repeats_into_segments: merge consecutive repeated tokens in a CTC prediction path into labeled Segment objects with start and end indices
load_wav2vec2_model_and_dict: download and load a pretrained wav2vec2 CTC alignment model and its token dictionary for multilingual speech alignment
get_token_spans_from_segments: compute time-aligned token spans from CTC segments by matching token letters and padding with silence boundaries
